entities.summary: Pascale Roze (b. 1954-03-22, Ho Chi Minh City) was a journalist or media commentator of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Ho Chi Minh City and France. Known in the fields of france, poets & playwrights, europe.
